issues.legal_issue: The limitation period for statutory recovery of a tax debt allowed to be paid in instalments runs from the date the final instalment was due, even when default on an earlier instalment makes the entire balance immediately recoverable.
material_facts: The assessment orders incorporated an agreement allowing the tax liability to be paid in instalments, with the final instalment scheduled for a later date.
The agreement provided that failure to pay any instalment would make the whole balance recoverable immediately.
The assessees failed to pay an instalment, and the revenue began recovery proceedings before the scheduled final instalment was due.
issues.conclusion: The recovery certificates were not barred by limitation because the instalment arrangement made the limitation period run from the date the final instalment was due, notwithstanding the earlier default and acceleration of the balance.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 46(7), proviso clause (iv), of the Indian Income-tax Act, 1922, where payment is allowed by instalments, the one-year limitation period is reckoned from the date the final instalment is due. The clause applies even if default on an earlier instalment makes the whole balance exigible; the instalment scheme brings the matter within the proviso rather than the main rule. The Court supplied the words “be reckoned,” which it considered inadvertently omitted from the clause. The majority cited no earlier cases. Justice Hegde dissented, reasoning that the due date had to be determined under sections 45 and 46 rather than by reference to the agreement, and that recovery was time-barred.

rule.if: tax_recovery_proceeding and sum_allowed_by_installments and schedule_incorporated_into_assessment and first_installment_missed and default_accelerated_balance and recovery_started_within_limit_from_final_installment

predicates.tax_recovery_proceeding: The matter is a proceeding to recover a tax debt through a statutory recovery mechanism.
predicates.sum_allowed_by_installments: The revenue allowed the assessed sum to be paid under an instalment schedule.
predicates.schedule_incorporated_into_assessment: The assessment orders incorporated the terms that provided for payment by instalments.
predicates.first_installment_missed: The taxpayer failed to pay an instalment when it was due.
predicates.default_accelerated_balance: The applicable payment terms made the entire balance recoverable after an instalment default.
predicates.recovery_started_within_limit_from_final: The revenue began recovery no later than the end of the limitation period measured from the scheduled due date of the final instalment.

issues.definition: When a tax recovery proceeding concerns a sum allowed by an instalment schedule incorporated into the assessment, an instalment is missed and accelerates the balance, and recovery begins within the limitation period measured from the final instalment, the recovery is not barred by limitation.
